title: The Origin of the World by Gustave Courbet
episode: Episode #53: Shock Art: Courbet's The Origin of the World (Season 5, Episode 7)
description: On Courbet’s frank close-up of a woman’s body, painted in 1866 for a private collector and hidden for over a century, later owned by the psychoanalyst Jacques Lacan. It went on display at the Orsay in 1995.
